content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Fresno

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree and formal project management education—no work experience needed. If you hold a high school diploma or equivalent and can complete the required contact hours, you qualify to apply. This makes CAPM ideal for Fresno professionals entering or transitioning into project management roles.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format covers the PMBOK® Guide essentials and exam domains in a structured, accelerated schedule. You'll learn directly from experienced instructors and gain the education hours PMI requires before application submission.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your contact hours, submit your CAPM application directly to PMI with your course completion certificate and required documentation. Pay the associated exam fee at that time. Granite PM Academy will guide you through each application requirement to ensure accuracy and timely processing.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and focused review sessions, to reinforce domain knowledge. Schedule your CAPM exam through Pearson VUE and take it at an authorized testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, you'll enter a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continued learning, volunteer work, or project experience. Plan ahead to accumulate your required PDUs and submit renewal documentation to PMI before your credential expires.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
